import math

def cosine(a, b):
    dot = sum(a[k] * b.get(k, 0) for k in a)
    na = math.sqrt(sum(v * v for v in a.values()))
    nb = math.sqrt(sum(v * v for v in b.values()))
    if na == 0 or nb == 0:
        return '0.000'
    return f'{dot / (na * nb):.3f}'
